questions.q:
The Union Cabinet on 10 March 2026 extended the Jal Jeevan Mission to December 2028. Consider the following statements:
1. The total outlay is Rs 8.69 lakh crore, with central assistance of Rs 3.59 lakh crore.
2. The mission shifts from building infrastructure to delivering service, with a unique Sujal Gaon ID for each village under the 'Sujalam Bharat' framework.
3. It aims to give tap connections to all 19.36 crore rural households by December 2028.
4. Funding is shared 50:50 between the Centre and States, including for Himalayan and North-Eastern States.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: For Himalayan and North-Eastern States the Centre-State split is 90:10; the 50:50 ratio applies to the other States. The Sujal Gaon ID was released across 31 States and UTs and linked to 67,000 Sujalam Bharat IDs.

questions.q:
The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship constituted a National Steering Committee for PM SETU. Consider the following statements:
1. PM SETU is a Rs 60,000 crore scheme approved in 2025.
2. 200 Hub ITIs will each mentor about four Spoke ITIs.
3. Each ITI is run by an SPV in which the Government holds 51 per cent and industry 49 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Industry holds 51 per cent and government 49 per cent of each ITI's SPV. Five NSTIs (Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kanpur and Ludhiana) will become global Centres of Excellence.
questions.h: Industry holds the majority in the SPV.

questions.q: Jan Aushadhi Diwas was observed on 7 March 2026. The Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) is administered by the
o: Department of Health and Family Welfare
questions.e: PMBJP offers about 2,110 medicines and 315 surgical items, aims to raise Kendras from over 18,000 to 25,000 by March 2027 and sells sanitary napkins at Re 1 a pad.

questions.q:
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs decided to convert Forest Rights Act Cells into Project Monitoring Units under the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA). Consider the following statements:
1. DAJGUA was launched in October 2024.
2. Each State/UT PMU will have four officials and each district two experts.
3. DAJGUA was launched in 2019.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme dates from October 2024. The Ministry cited administrative costs and silos created by separate cells.

questions.q:
The Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA) told State Adoption Resource Agencies to follow adoption procedures strictly. Consider the following statements:
1. CARA is a statutory body under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, with statutory status under the JJ Act, 2015.
2. It is the Central Authority for inter-country adoption under the Hague Convention of 1993, which India ratified in 2003.
3. Parents adopting under the Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 must register the adoption deed with CARA.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Adoption under the Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 does not require registration of the deed with CARA, so statement 3 is wrong. CARA was set up in 1990 and handles in-country adoption of orphan, abandoned and surrendered children, and for surrendered children a two-month reconsideration period must be followed.

questions.q:
NITI Aayog and UNICEF India signed a Statement of Intent under the IMPAct4Nutrition (I4N) platform for aspirational districts and blocks. Consider the following statements:
1. I4N links businesses with the social movement around POSHAN 2.0.
2. Its ACE Card initiative covers assets, CSR and employee engagement for nutrition.
3. I4N is run by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare without any private participation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: I4N is a platform for mobilising private action for nutrition, so statement 3 is wrong. It is a hub of knowledge and resources that connects businesses to POSHAN 2.0, which aims to improve key nutrition indicators for children and women.

questions.q: NITI Aayog released the second edition of the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) in 2026. Which of the following States were classified as 'Achievers' among the 18 major States?
questions.e: West Bengal, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Punjab were 'Aspirational'. Arunachal Pradesh topped the 10 North-Eastern and Himalayan States. The five pillars are quality of expenditure, revenue mobilisation, fiscal prudence, debt index and debt sustainability.

questions.q:
The World Happiness Report 2026 was released on 20 March 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. India was ranked 116th, up from 118th in 2025.
2. Finland was first for the ninth consecutive year.
3. The report is produced by the UNDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: It is produced by Oxford's Wellbeing Research Centre with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network. Nepal ranked 99th, Pakistan 104th, Bangladesh 127th and Sri Lanka 134th.

questions.q:
The UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation released 'Levels and Trends in Child Mortality'. Consider the following statements:
1. There were an estimated 4.9 million under-five deaths worldwide in 2024.
2. India's under-five mortality fell 79 per cent, from 127 to 27 per 1,000 live births, between 1990 and 2024.
3. India's neonatal mortality fell from 57 to 27 per 1,000 live births.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India's neonatal mortality fell from 57 to 17. Sub-Saharan Africa accounted for 58 per cent of under-five deaths and Southern Asia 25 per cent.

questions.q:
The Consumer Justice Report 2026, released by the India Justice Report, assessed consumer dispute redressal commissions. Consider the following statements:
1. Case pendency rose by 21 per cent between 2020 and 2024.
2. Only 134 cases were referred to mediation across the 23 States that gave data.
3. The share of women among presidents and members of State Commissions rose between 2021 and 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The share of women in the 14 responding State Commissions fell from an average of 35 per cent in 2021 to 29 per cent in 2025, so statement 3 is wrong. Disposal improved to 88.5 per cent of 7.64 lakh cases, yet pendency still grew, and nearly half of State Commissions lacked a sitting president.

questions.q:
NITI Aayog's evaluation of PM-JAY reported out-of-pocket spending. Consider the following statements:
1. Average out-of-pocket spending was Rs 53,965 per hospitalisation in private hospitals and Rs 21,827 in government hospitals.
2. About 65 per cent of beneficiaries still paid out of pocket.
3. PM-JAY was launched in September 2018 under the National Health Authority.
4. PM-JAY gives cover of Rs 10 lakh per family per year.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The cover is Rs 5 lakh per family per year. Over 42 crore Ayushman cards had been issued by December 2025.

questions.q:
StartupBlink's Innovators Business Environment Index (IBEI) 2026 ranked India 54th. Consider the following statements:
1. India's score was 55.035, ahead of China, which ranked 85th.
2. The US ranked first, Singapore second and the UK third.
3. The index is published by the World Bank.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: IBEI is a StartupBlink index scoring countries from 0 to 100 on business-environment inputs, not a World Bank product.

questions.q:
National Vaccination Day (16 March 2026) was marked with data from the Ministry of Health. Consider the following statements:
1. Full immunisation coverage was 98.4 per cent by January 2026.
2. A nationwide HPV vaccination and an indigenous Td vaccine were launched in 2026.
3. The Universal Immunisation Programme covers 25 diseases.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The UIP covers 12 diseases. Zero-dose children fell from 0.11 per cent in 2023 to 0.06 per cent in 2024.

questions.q:
World TB Day (24 March 2026) had the WHO theme 'Yes! We can End TB!'. Consider the following statements:
1. India achieved its 2025 TB elimination target.
2. India accounts for about 25 per cent of global TB cases.
3. The Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana support was raised to Rs 1,000 a month.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India missed its 2025 elimination target, although treatment coverage rose from 53 per cent in 2015 to 92 per cent in 2024 and success rate reached 90 per cent.

questions.q:
20 March 2026 marked the start of the centenary year of the Mahad Satyagraha. Consider the following statements:
1. Dr B.R. Ambedkar led the 1927 march to the Chavdar Tank.
2. 20 March is observed as Social Empowerment Day.
3. The satyagraha was launched against the salt tax.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: It asserted the right of Dalits to use public water. A 1937 Bombay High Court ruling opened the tank to all communities.

questions.q: The Ashmolean Museum, Oxford returned a 16th-century bronze of Thirumangai Alvar to India. Thirumangai Alvar belonged to which tradition?
o: The Alvars, Vaishnava bhakti saints of the Tamil country
questions.e: He is counted as the 12th and last of the Alvars. The statue was traced to the Soundararaja Perumal temple in Tamil Nadu by the India Pride Project using 1957 photographs of the French Institute of Pondicherry.

questions.q:
The Ministry of Culture launched a three-month nationwide manuscript survey under the Gyan Bharatam Mission. Consider the following statements:
1. Survey data feeds a national digital repository.
2. State committees are chaired by Chief Secretaries and district committees by District Magistrates.
3. Survey teams use the Kosh app.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Teams use the Gyan Bharatam app.

questions.q:
The Archaeological Survey of India approved excavations at eight sites in Tamil Nadu. Consider the following statements:
1. The sites include Keeladi and Adichanallur.
2. Keeladi lies on the banks of the Vaigai river in Sivaganga district.
3. Adichanallur lies in Madurai district.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Adichanallur lies in Thoothukudi district on the Tamiraparani river, not in Madurai district, so statement 3 is wrong. The eight sites are Keeladi, Adichanallur, Karivalamvanthanallur, Vellalore, Thelunganur, Nagapattinam, Pattinamarudur and Manikollai.

questions.q:
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs organised the Tribes Art Fest 2026. Consider the following statements about GI tags:
1. Warli received its GI tag in 2014.
2. Gond received its GI tag in 2023.
3. Saura received its GI tag in 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Saura received its GI tag in 2024; Sohrai and Khobar in 2020, and Pithora in 2021.

questions.q:
The Geological Survey of India declared the hill region around Kalinjar Fort a National Geo-Heritage Site. Consider the following statements:
1. The region is in Banda district, Uttar Pradesh.
2. The declaration was made by the Geological Survey of India.
3. The Geological Survey of India functions under the Ministry of Culture.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The GSI works under the Ministry of Mines.

questions.q:
India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 on 8 March 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final at Ahmedabad.
2. India became the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles.
3. Sanju Samson was Player of the Match in the final.
4. The tournament was co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Jasprit Bumrah (4/15) was Player of the Match; Samson was Player of the Tournament with 321 runs.

questions.q:
The Union Minister of State for Youth Affairs and Sports launched a nationwide athletics league at 250 locations under ASMITA. Consider the following statements:
1. ASMITA is a Khelo India initiative started in 2021 to promote women's sports.
2. It has seen nearly 3 lakh women take part in 33 disciplines across 2,600 leagues.
3. It is run by the Ministry of Education.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: ASMITA is run by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports under Khelo India, not by the Ministry of Education, so statement 3 is wrong. The new athletics league spans 250 locations.

questions.q:
R. Vairamuthu was announced as the 60th Jnanpith Award recipient on 14 March 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. He is the third Tamil writer to receive it, after P.V. Akilan and D. Jayakanthan.
2. The award carries Rs 21 lakh.
3. The Jnanpith Award was instituted in 1961.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The award carries Rs 11 lakh, a bronze statuette of Vagdevi and a citation. The selection committee was chaired by Pratibha Ray.

questions.q: The Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025 were announced on 16 March 2026 in 24 languages. Navtej Sarna won the English award for the novel
questions.e: Mamta Kalia won for the Hindi memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'. Each award carries Rs 1 lakh and a copper plaque.

questions.q:
The inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games began on 25 March 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. It is India's first national multi-sport event exclusively for tribal athletes.
2. It is hosted in Odisha.
3. It includes indigenous sports such as kabaddi and mallakhamb.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: It is held in Chhattisgarh (Raipur, Jagdalpur and Surguja), with mascot 'Morveer'.
